Definition: Ashtaroth, the name of a Sidonian deity, and of a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Ashtaroth is the city of Og king of Bashan, and the name of the goddess whose house holds Saul's armour. Moses names Og, who dwelt at Astaroth, Samuel tells Israel to put away the strange gods and Ashtaroth and serve the LORD only, and the Philistines put Saul's armour in the house of Ashtaroth after they take his body.
TheologicalSignificance: A name that is both a city of giants and a house for a dead king's armour tells me that Ashtaroth stands for the old powers Israel had to leave behind: the gods of the Canaanites and the armour of a fallen king both end up in her house.
